description: a24rc1r + jump (ud) as a SAMPLED attack-style impulse: move.jump_sample=true replaces the legacy ud argmax with a per-tick Bernoulli on sigmoid((pos-none+jump_bias)/jump_temp) off the move decode threaded rng. Op-masked +jump is a 1-tick impulse (median 1f, 80% single-tick), NOT a dwell, so no sticky/hazard/hold; engine gates feasibility. Fixes the argmax jump-collapse. Also bumped to p99 overall aim skill (look.aim_mag_gain alpha=0.1, super-band p99 anchor; rc1r was p95/0.05). Other move/weapon/guard params identical to rc1r. jump_bias=-0.21 calibrated to human P(jump|feasible)=2.27% (input_mask bit7 feasible / op_input bit2 executed). PATCH (bugfix, aim-only, no other behavior change): + RL feet-aim pitch bias 3.5° via look.weapon_pitch_bias[7]. RL was firing a static ~1.5° ABOVE the feet anchor (straight no-gravity rocket → flies over → lands behind); offset is immune to β and z_rate feed-forward (a static az/el-coupled decode gap), so a fixed downward bias is the right compensation. Closed-loop (β=0.8): fire-pitch −1.51°→−0.08°, acc 0.438→0.459, dmg +12%. JUMP REVERT: move.jump_sample=false → TRUE deterministic argmax jump (the export jump-gumbel is now gated off under argmax, so deployed == offline argmax; jump_bias/jump_temp are inert in this mode). Sampled jump fired at ~human rate but RANDOM times (head onset signal is weak), reading as over-frequent unmotivated hops; argmax fires only the model most-confident jump frames (fewer, higher-precision). No threshold. ATTACK→GREEDY: attack.threshold=0.25 (reuses the retired engine-side sigmoid>threshold, now in-graph) → deterministic fire iff sigmoid(fire_logit+bias)≥0.25 (replaces per-tick Bernoulli). Calibrated to human fire frequency (137 shots/ep, == sampled; closed-loop sweep). Deterministic fire commits on the confident tick so it co-occurs with jump+aim → restores coordinated actions (rocket-jump) that independent fire-sampling broke. Costs ~+0.02 accuracy; ~−0.35° RL fire-pitch erosion (determinism selects body-aimed frames; RL pitch bias RE-SWEPT to 4.0 under greedy attack (centers fire-pitch on the feet; 3.5 was fit under sampled fire and left it ~0.56° high)); void-fire unchanged (an aim, not confidence, problem).
